## Install

Unity **2022.3.12f1** or later. No other dependencies.

*Window > Package Manager > + > Add package from git URL...*

```
https://github.com/xpTURN/Polyfill.git?path=src/Polyfill/Assets/Polyfill#__TAG__
```

Or in `Packages/manifest.json`:

```json
"com.xpturn.polyfill": "https://github.com/xpTURN/Polyfill.git?path=src/Polyfill/Assets/Polyfill#__TAG__"
```

Syntax newer than C# 9 also needs a newer language version: in **Edit > Project Settings > xpTURN Polyfill** (or **Edit > Polyfill > Settings…**), turn on **Apply to all installed platforms**, choose a **Version** and press **Apply** — see [Project settings](https://github.com/xpTURN/Polyfill/blob/__TAG__/README.md#project-settings-c-language-version).
